steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Forget your poor brother and elope with me, Lady Dupont!

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: Come to your senses, Second Rockefeller!

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: You heard the Messenger. There is no 'Lady Dupont'. That nobility, elegance, intelligence... everything you loved about me is but dust in the wind.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: I am not worthy to be your wife. Not yours, nor your brothers'.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: I'd still love you, even without the Dupont name!

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: It was your brother, the dead man, who had been using you all this time. You're an innocent victim in all this deception. Don't blame yourself.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: But?

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: But the reception hall is filled with guests, come to pay their respects. The name Dupont may be an illusion, but it would not be appropriate for me to leave this house right in front of them...

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Don't worry, my love, I know a way to leave this manor now, and be free of these family conflicts forever.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: How?

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Have you forgotten? I'm a soldier.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Look!

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: Th-This is...

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: I made this wire from materials I found in the storage room. It will take us from this balcony, across the garden, and into the forests behind the manor.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Come with me, to a place where wealth and status don't matter!

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: Oh, my dear soldier, your methods are so crude!

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: What if your pulley gets stuck? We would be hanging in the air for hours, until someone finds us... Or the rope could snap, sending us plummeting into the forests.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Trust me, it's very safe. I would never let any harm come to you.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: I-Is it? I-I think I'm going to fall—

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: No—!
'Someone just fell! Call the ambulance, now! There's blood everywhere... Don't just stand there, Shelly!'
She feels a chill run up her spine. She cannot move even her fingers. The sound of fraying cords pulls at her nerves.
'What on Terra happened...?'
'An accident caused by an aging wire rig? And the case is closed, just like that? Someone died!'
No... the two accidents were not alike. Dalton died from a stab wound, while the actress from five years ago died from a fall.
She hears that ominous sound again. Where is it coming from?
...Shelly? Shelly!
Get away from there! The container's about to fall!

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: F-Fall?
Shelly looks up in a daze.
The container hanging in mid-air is coming closer and closer, as though she is the one hanging in mid-air, and she is about to fall.
As it fills her vision, a shadow appears next to her, and a pair of strong hands grabs her by the shoulder.
Shelly feels the world spin. By the time she comes to her senses, she is standing on the other side of the set, safe and sound.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Lucian... th-thank you.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: You can let go now.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Oh, sorry.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Not you.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Moira, yes? You can let go now.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: A-Alright...
Only then does Shelly see the small frame of the prop master, grabbing the rope connected to the container with all her might, her arms trembling and her face red.
Only when Lucian repeats his words does she slowly release it.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: You're too on edge.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: I-It's my job as prop master.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: What happened...?

steps.name: Staff
steps.text: We should be asking YOU that!

steps.name: Staff
steps.text: Sure, these containers are getting old, and need to be checked to ensure the ropes don't get loose, but—

steps.name: Staff
steps.text: Are you out of you mind?!

steps.name: Staff
steps.text: Not only did you interrupt the shot by screaming out of nowhere, you didn't even budge when that thing was about to fall on you!

steps.name: Staff
steps.text: What could have spooked you like that? Is this your first time seeing a wire rig or what?!

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: No... Seeing Melanie and Michael brought back memories of that fall five years ago—

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Go take a break, Shelly. You're getting in the way of the shooting.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: (Leaps over a prop box)

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: (Brushes against Lucian)

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: N-No, I mean, I was just spooked by that mysterious black creature running around over there...

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Sorry. Please continue.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: (Unhappily swishes tails)

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: You know, Shelly's not half-bad looking, but she's always so jumpy, and it makes me uneasy.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: A shame the scene was interrupted. I was just getting into my role...

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: 'Getting into your role'?

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: You ought to be thanking her for interrupting that take, because I was about to chew your head off.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: Your delivery, your posture, your expressions... We've been at this for two months, and you've shown no sign of improvement. That rookie could act circles around you on his first day in front of a camera.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: I thought I told you to keep your private life off the set. It would seem Greta was wrong about you.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: It was a mistake to give the leading role to a pretty boy who gets cast from the color of his ears alone. And three different roles in the same film, no less.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: You're right.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: Hmph. Why the sudden modesty?

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: Normally, you'd be coming up with all sorts of flippant excuses by now.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: I was just thinking about poor old Dalton...

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: I don't have anywhere near your experience. And Shelly's close call just now has left me a little shaken.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: Be professional.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: Accidents, failures, bad reviews... You'll never make it in Wrankwood if you let little things like that affect you.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: I could learn a lot from you in that regard.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: I heard you were standing right behind Marianne when she swept the Wrankwood Awards with a film completed in just twenty-eight days?

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: And that after coming home empty-handed and being ridiculed by the press, you went back to the set the very same day to continue shooting.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: I'd have quit ages ago if I had to compete with a superstar like that.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: And what's that supposed to mean?

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: I... oh!

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: No no no, I didn't mean it like that! You've just been so calm in the face of Dalton's death, and I wanted to know your secret. That's all, I swear!

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: Secret? There's no secret. It's only because I didn't know him that well, and had nothing to do with his accident.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: You, though.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: Why is his death affecting you so much? Were you involved in it?

spans.text: so much? Were you involved in it?

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Could it all be a coincidence?

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Am I just imagining things?

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Should I see a psychiatrist?
You shouldn't use Miss.Christine as an excuse.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Who's there?!

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: She wasn't where you said she was, and wouldn't have run around in a way that would disturb you.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Please apologize to her on my behalf.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: I will.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: What is it you're so afraid of?

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: ...What I'm NOT afraid of, after that accident on set five years ago?

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: I know that look. Curiosity.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: I mean, I can tell you—it's not exactly a secret. You could find out with just a little digging.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Her name was Laura.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: She was a rookie actress in Wrankwood who caught Greta's eye. Extremely passionate about her work, but knew nothing about the unspoken rules of the business.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Dalton was already an alcoholic at the time, but he was still a big name. He decided to put her in her place, by adding extra scenes that kept her in a wire rig for six, seven hours.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Until the wires broke... and she fell to her death.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: The way the blood spread out from under her... It was just like what happened to Dalton...
Lucian looks at Shelly's arm. There are marks of self-harm all over it, signs of the impact the incident has had on her.
Shelly pulls down her sleeves, her face filled with anxiety.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: But I can take care of my own problems.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: You're underestimating those problems.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: This will only become more frequent. At first, only similar sounds would trigger the hallucinations, but now, even the sound of a chair being dragged can take you back into the past.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Gee, thanks for the concern, 'Doctor Lucian'.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: I've dealt with these wicked voices in my head for five years. I know them better than anyone.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: All I can do is outrace them. Do as much as I can before fear and irrationality take over.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Maybe Dalton's death really was just an accident. But either way, I have to eliminate any possible risk, any possible threat, to prevent that incident five years ago from happening all over again.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Even if the threat is coming from the film crew itself...

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: There's something else you're concerned about.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Greta's hiding something.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: We share an office. I saw a strange document on her desk before the plate left central Wrankwood. She stopped me when I was about to open it.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: The riddles just keep piling up, but everyone I know who was there back then and went through the same thing would rather not bring it up. No way can we talk about this with each other openly.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: And now, I'm being constantly interrupted by these voices and hallucinations...

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Pain can mitigate them.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: ...What did you say?

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: I said 'pain'.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: It won't rid you of your anxiety or panic attacks, but it will give you time to breathe, to do what you really want to do, and solve the unsolved mysteries.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: The voices and shadows hide in tiny corners, impeding and distracting you as you try to find yourself...

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Pain is one form of resistance, though fingernails alone may not be enough.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: The tip of a pen, or a knife... With the proper application of force, any sharp object can be of help.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: The tongue, the back of the hand, the top of the thigh... Those areas are more sensitive to pain.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: You... You're a weird guy, you know that? But you sound like you know what you're talking about with hallucinations.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Have you ever had to calm yourself like that?

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Who are you?
Pain is a form of mitigation.
Strange whispers, strange sights...
Except, unlike Shelly, the problem he faces is not the fear of these things, but the desire for them.

steps.name: Troupe Member A
steps.text: Lucian hasn't returned the Originium phonograph yet?

steps.name: Troupe Member B
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Troupe Member B
steps.text: He must be anxious. Didn't Whiteflower say he's had trouble sleeping?

steps.name: Troupe Member B
steps.text: Too much superficiality in his ecstasy and anguish. He doesn't understand more complex, more extreme emotions. It limits his performances.

steps.name: Troupe Member A
steps.text: But he's young. Why the rush?

steps.name: Troupe Member B
steps.text: It's been six or seven years since Lucian joined. With his beautiful voice, he was considered a rising star at first, and the leader instructed him personally.

steps.name: Troupe Member B
steps.text: But he's hit a wall now that he's finally in a lead role.

steps.name: Troupe Member A
steps.text: Listening to those records won't solve anything!

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Emotions are an actor's weapons. The first step is to understand them.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Master said your ecstasy and anguish are merely superficial. That imitation will only compromise your perception of more complex emotions.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: But how...

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Despair. True despair will cost you what you hold most dear, yet at the same time open a new door.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: You will listen to the whispers you have never listened to, witness everything you have never witnessed, and understand all the emotions that you never understood...

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: You shall become drama itself, the mirror of all things.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Like this—

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: *cough* *cough*—
Lucian destroyed his own voice.
Originium pours into the wound, and he is inundated in pain and despair.

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Blood...

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Ow...

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: It's alright, Lucian! I'm here!

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: What happened?!

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: (Hoarse sobbing)

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: (Changed voice) So... this is...

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Did you do this to yourself, Lucian?

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Do you remember my last performance... or rather, assassination?

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: I failed. They called me a pathetic coward.

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: I'm no longer a favored son of the arts. I don't care about being isolated or scorned, because my heart had already left the Troupe after that performance...

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: But I stayed... because we came from the same place, because we're... friends.

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: You promised you wouldn't be like them...

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Master... was right...

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: I'm scared... of this Troupe, and of who you are now.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: In any case, it will be even more effective than you expect.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: I just hope I never need to use that trick of yours.
